text:
Situation: Fluconazole 50 mg tablets have been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-01-13 and remain listed as of 2026-10-21, a span of 57 months. Corvale East holds 164 tablets with 12.8 days on hand. Corvale General holds 289 tablets with 17.6 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show fluconazole has been continuously listed in shortage since 2022-01-13. The registered manufacturing plant Novitium Pharma LLC (FEI 3012541241) received a VAI classification on 2019-02-04, which was 1074 days before the shortage posting. The relabeler Golden State Medical Supply, Inc. (FEI 3006458969) has a history including an OAI classification on 2011-02-02 and a Warning Letter on 2011-04-26, though its most recent inspection was NAI on 2025-06-11.

Our position: Current inventory provides less than 18 days of supply across both sites. Multiple alternate manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today, though their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (not on FDA shortage list) — requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Aurobindo Pharma Limited (not on FDA shortage list) — requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to place orders with AvPAK (not on FDA shortage list) — requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to place orders with BluePoint Laboratories (not on FDA shortage list) — requires buyer approval.
5. Buyer to place orders with Chartwell RX, LLC (not on FDA shortage list) — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
